*Dinner:* the call goes out at *3:00 PM*. Answers close at 4:30 PM, voting at 5:15 PM, and the usual meal time is 6:30 PM.
*Lunch:* no daily call.
*Breakfast:* no daily call.

elements.text: Anyone in the household can change it. Each change is posted in the Dinnerbell channel.
